## Reconciled October14 status

The one-literal default repair is compiled and tested in the staged frontend. Nine default/retained-choice controls pass. A ROM alone leaves Recent empty; importing its synthetic gamelist history populates Recent without gameplay. The large-profile corrected chooser frames show default Recent/Favorites and preservation of explicit Favorites-only.

Remaining: final-source/image qualification while preserving existing player choices. This is distinct from the unknown original author of the Nova's historical metadata. Local evidence: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-13-setup-qualification/installed/README.md`; the old body’s unimplemented status is historical. No original failed API/fixture result is reclassified.

This is a scoped readiness update under #585; all broader unproved acceptance criteria remain open. Earlier sections below retain their dated source/evidence history.

## Earlier intake and evidence history

## Discovered during the owner's requested M7 testing — October 13

Owner direction:
> Got it. Can we start working through all of these issues we've discovered and figure out what we need to do to be able to start bringing them to resolution? There's additional testing to do. Let's go ahead and do that first. I'd like to be able to work towards our next release candidate.

The fresh accepted VM20 image has no explicit `CollectionSystemsAuto` override. Its `/systems` API lists Favorites but omits Recent; `/systems/recent/games` returns HTTP404 even after a synthetic ROM-side gamelist loads playcount5 and a previous lastplayed timestamp. This surfaced during #565's library-copy fixture. The initial fixture incorrectly treated404 as an empty collection; preserve its original failure and do not call the first case a valid Recent-membership proof.

Accepted ES `c8dc72cf9e`, `Settings.cpp`: compiled default is `favorites, recent`. `CollectionSystemManager::loadEnabledListFromSettings()` splits on commas and compares exact names. `Utils::String::split()` preserves spaces; ` recent` therefore misses `recent`. History attributes the default to `401d97370d55e3161437c2f38182224ed1322dac`. Current official upstream Settings.cpp still has the same default (blob `89b3f482e49a6d7420c9eab19108c5c61eca32b9`, checked October13); no default-string fix there.

Can this be done on the VM? **Yes.** Compare absent override, spaced list and canonical list on the same installed image, with synthetic gamelist data and no game/account/cloud operation. Record API status and enabled collection names, not only row count. Then repair the default and qualify the actual compiled source; preserve explicit player choices on retained installs.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Bounded VM control distinguishes missing/default, spaced and canonical `favorites,recent` settings; HTTP status and list membership prove the parser/default mismatch, with original failed fixture preserved.
- [x] The corrected compiled frontend on a clean configuration exposes the intended default collections; synthetic ROM-only has no Recent entry, while importing matching history creates the expected entry without launching a game.
- [x] Explicit retained collection choices are preserved; no forced enablement of a collection the player disabled. Focused regression evidence covers the chosen default/parser repair.
- [x] Canonical collection flow/reference and reviewed same-source clean/retained frames accompany the fix; syntax check precedes pin promotion.

Parent M7/#344; found while testing #565. Place with the setup/collection repairs before renewed candidate qualification. No installed source fix is claimed yet.


Four unchanged-image controls completed: absent/default404, spaced404, canonical200 with imported history, explicit-favorites404. [Results and original failure boundaries](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/4d5c26807d92e0535b8a5e796c8e6446aab47c6c/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-13-library-wifi-baseline/README.md). Product default repair, compiled-source clean/retained regressions and frames remain due; no pin moved.
